decision: Wave 0 is toolchain-compatible after a deterministic pre-flight setup: use Node 22.23.1 and invoke vendored Yarn 4.13.0 with node .yarn/releases/yarn-4.13.0.cjs. No Codebase change or frozen-plan change is required.
softRisks: Current local Node is v24.18.0 and must be switched to 22.23.1 before Wave 0.
Yarn is not on PATH; commands must use the vendored .yarn/releases/yarn-4.13.0.cjs path.
Native build/package/installer verification remains later-wave work.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The exact supported runtime and package-manager versions are proven from repository files.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: package.json engines node >=22.12.0 <23.0.0, .nvmrc 22.23.1, packageManager yarn@4.13.0, .yarnrc.yml yarnPath .yarn/releases/yarn-4.13.0.cjs.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A compatible Node runtime is available or a deterministic pre-Wave-0 setup action is established.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Current node v24.18.0 is incompatible, but the deterministic action is install/use Node 22.23.1 and invoke vendored Yarn 4.13.0.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Wave 0 build and test commands are portable or have explicit platform-specific owners.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: TEST_COMMAND_REGISTRY.json maps 20 available commands to vendored Yarn; cross-platform matrix covers Windows x64, macOS arm64/x64, Linux x64.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Native/Electron module compatibility has no unresolved hard blocker.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Electron ^39.0.0, @affine/native N-API targets six platforms, precompiled .node modules supported; Wave 0 is KEEP verification.

commandRegistrySummary.note: Available commands use node .yarn/releases/yarn-4.13.0.cjs; unavailable commands are later installer/licence/SBOM/offline/restoration work.

keyRepositoryFacts.fact: Vendored Yarn reports version 4.13.0 when invoked with node.
TEST_COMMAND_REGISTRY has 20 available and 6 unavailable commands.
